verdict.rationale: Fivetran's core product is background automation. Connectors sync data automatically and handle schema changes and incremental syncs. Transformations run automatically after syncs or on a set schedule, which is a recurring schedule rather than a one-off action. A community report says syncing has been very reliable, though another user reports occasional out-of-sync issues that needed re-syncs. Missing for 10: general-purpose automations beyond data sync and transformations, and detailed documentation of sync-frequency and schedule configuration (only '1-minute syncs' on the pricing page).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Fivetran provides pre-built data connectors that automatically sync data from your applications, databases, event streams, and files to your data warehouse or data lake.
Transformations are automatically executed after connection syncs or on a set schedule.
Each connector handles schema changes, API updates, and incremental syncs automatically — no data pipelines to maintain.
Fivetran's syncing has been very reliable (compared to others we tried)
